description: Saudi Aramco Trading Co. - OCTG Casing tender inquiry (Phase 3 of South Ghawar Field Expansion)
expected_outcome: Grade B inquiry; legitimate buyers from Volza; best_match = OCTG-L80-PREMIUM; quotation FOB=$780K; healthy profit; accept_round_2 outcome

inquiry.raw_text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Good day. We are interested in sourcing API 5CT OCTG Casing for our upstream operations in Saudi Arabia.

Product: API 5CT L80 Casing, 9-5/8 inch, BTC connection, suitable for sour service (NACE MR0175 required).
Quantity: 5000 meters, delivery in two batches.
Port: CIF Jeddah Islamic Port, Saudi Arabia
Target unit price: around USD 1450 per meter, budget flexible for qualified suppliers.
Expected delivery: Q4 2026, first batch by October 2026.

This inquiry is for South Ghawar Field Expansion Phase 3. We are acting as procurement on behalf of Saudi Aramco Trading Co. (EPC contractor: Technicas Reunidas).

Tender reference: ARAMCO-TR-2026-Q3-OCTG-007
Project timeline: first shipment by 2026-10, final delivery 2026-12-31.

Please send your quotation with technical compliance statement, mill test certificates, and sour-service qualification. We need full traceability per Saudi Aramco Standards.

Best regards,
Mr. Ahmed Al-Rashid
Senior Procurement Manager
Saudi Aramco Trading Co. (SATC)
P.O. Box 5000, Dhahran 31311, Saudi Arabia
Email: ahmed.alrashid@aramco-trading.example.com
Phone: +966 13 872 1234
WhatsApp: +966 50 123 4567
